dataset: Field observations the model is evaluated against
retrieved: inherited with the dissertation; re-filed here 2026-08-08

centrella_2020_ny_orchards.csv.study: Centrella et al. (2020), Journal of Applied Ecology
centrella_2020_ny_orchards.csv.design: 17 Finger Lakes apple orchards stocked with Osmia cornifrons nest tubes on 2015-05-05; emergence 2015-05-07; tubes collected at 3 time points to 2015-06-24
centrella_2020_ny_orchards.csv.response: brood cells, reconstructed as (males + females) / (1 - larval mortality); the file records emerged adults, not cells

turley_2022_pa_blue_vane.csv.design: blue vane traps at 8 locations around the Penn State Fruit Research and Extension Center, Adams County PA, weekly April-October 2014-2019
turley_2022_pa_blue_vane.csv.response: annual count of Osmia specimens (183 of 26,716 rows), six numbers

rebuild: re-download from the cited sources; both files are small enough to be tracked in git, so a clone already has them
